choices.why: Its black-brown wood is the darkest of the three, and its clean, sober lines and compact 105 cm width fit neatly under the small window on the right wall.
It is the only truly ergonomic option, all black with a mesh back and adjustable arms, and it looks lighter and more modern than the bulky executive chair.
It is genuinely low and wide (160 x 90 cm), suits the long left wall, and its black metal frame with a grey-toned wood top brings in exactly the black and grey the user asked for.
This all-black articulated work lamp matches the chair and the desk, and it gives directed light for working.
It is leather, light and fairly compact for the corner by the tall window, and its black-brown frame echoes the desk.

answer.why: The black-brown desk and armchair frame, the black chair, lamp and shelf frame, and the grey-toned wood top make a sober palette that sits naturally on the dark floor against the white walls. The armchair's leather adds a single warm accent for the reading corner.
